channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
item.description: Amazon SageMaker Inference feature that supports GPU partitioning with NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints.

item.title: [news] Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
item.description: As we built Amazon Quick, its agents grew from answering questions to taking actions, and the same primitives kept getting rebuilt under different names.

item.title: [news] Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
item.description: Serverless Model Context Protocol server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate that gives AI agents secure, metadata-driven access to an enterprise data lake.

item.title: [news] Quoting Nilay Patel
item.description: The products aren't good enough to sell people on the costs. You cannot tell people that you have to listen to the whine of a data center in their backyard for AI overviews and some of the most hilarious deep fake slop in history. It's not worth it.

item.title: [news] Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
item.description: In Part 1 you built one governed agent.

item.title: [news] Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 1
item.description: An AI agent that acts for a user raises an identity question that per-app OAuth and service accounts leave open: which agent may act for which user, and how you stop it.

item.title: [news] How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

item.title: [news] Taxbit Assist: A grounded, role-aware AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Taxbit built Taxbit Assist, a cited, permission-aware AI assistant embedded in its enterprise dashboard, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

item.title: [news] Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls
item.description: Integration that runs Claude Code as a remote agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore helps execute isolated coding tasks and returns GitHub pull requests.

item.title: [tool] Agentic Identity Broker, OAuth Delegation for AI Agents
item.description: Agentic Identity Broker is an open-source OAuth2 broker that enables users to grant AI agents scoped and revocable access to third-party services.

item.title: [news] University libraries are being swarmed by AI bots, putting public access at risk
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from cbc.ca. 111 points and 52 comments.

item.title: [news] ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
[news] Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
item.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash provides native 15-second video generation and editing with improved consistency and 30% lower pricing for scalable content production.

item.title: [news] I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
item.description: I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser.

item.title: [news] Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
item.description: OpenAI partners with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test third-party service connections, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

item.title: [news] I struggle to believe that AI R&D is ingenious
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from lesswrong.com. 161 points and 166 comments.

item.title: [repo] knot07/AegisOps
item.description: AegisOps is an AI security operations workbench that integrates intelligent dialogue, alert adjudication, workflows, and vulnerability management.

item.title: [news] Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
[news] Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
item.description: BioBasicsBench is a 100-task benchmark introduced by OpenAI to measure how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

item.title: [news] Launch HN: Rivet (YC W23) – Scale and Orchestrate Agents on S3
item.description: Rivet is a high-density and scalable orchestrator for agentic workloads that runs lightweight actors backed by Amazon S3.

item.title: [news] Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
[news] Building a Multi-Agent System from Scratch: Architecture Patterns
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from kadhar.dev. 100 points and 43 comments.

item.title: [paper] Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
item.description: A token pruning and merging mechanism and a waveform-preserving augmentation improve a full-waveform LiDAR Transformer to real-time speed and higher accuracy with better generalization.

item.title: [paper] Reducing Representational Interference in Retrieval Embeddings with Trainable Prefix Tokens
item.description: Prepending trainable [DUMP] tokens during embedding model training reduces residual token-level signals and improves retrieval representations without changing architecture, pooling, or loss.

item.title: [paper] Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space
item.description: Firms’ capacity adjustments to cash-flow shocks are modeled as costly competitive moves and tested through simulation and news/analyst data using language-model-based relevance measures.

item.title: [paper] On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
item.description: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost.

item.title: [repo] AuremHQ/weight-space-programming
item.description: Engineering tool for small models that allows users to fix open-weight models by editing their weights directly without retraining.

item.title: [repo] smokeeaasd/flawless-ui-ux
item.description: UI/UX skill for coding agents designed to build distinctive and usable user interfaces for various product audiences.

item.title: [paper] HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
item.description: A hierarchical VLA framework is proposed to address the limitations of Markovian models by maintaining task history through explicit language memory and event-triggered updates.

item.title: [repo] didilili/mianstack
item.description: Open-source programmer interview question bank containing real interview experiences, high-frequency topics, project breakdowns, and technical reference answers for career preparation.

item.title: [paper] Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
item.description: DPDM improves agent decision accuracy by combining frozen language-model representations with a shared pretrained conditional predictor that learns from deployment evidence without parameter updates.

item.title: [repo] jolovicdev/bowerbird
item.description: Bowerbird is an open-source research notebook that lets users query local documents, web pages, and media while verifying quotes against sources.

item.title: [repo] Javihaus/zeropoint
item.description: CPU-first, energy-based decision model that picks the option that fits or accurately identifies when none of the options do.

item.title: [paper] SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
item.description: A pipeline combining Arc2Face diffusion with flow matching on identity embeddings generates a balanced synthetic face dataset to improve fairness and reduce privacy risks in generative model training.

item.title: [paper] OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
item.description: OpenFrontiers links a broad corpus of open research problems with a formally graded benchmark of recently resolved mathematics problems to evaluate LLM agents’ ability to rediscover solutions under different information-access conditions.

item.title: [model] Viggle/Viggle-Remake
item.description: Video to video model from Viggle. 43.5k downloads and 128 likes so far.

item.title: [tool] Harness Leaderboard
item.description: Which coding-agent harness should you use for your model?

item.title: [repo] HerdBuilderEstimate/roblox-studio-mcp
item.description: Roblox Studio MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that connects AI coding assistants to Roblox Studio to automate Lua scripting, inspect object trees, and run playtests safely.

item.title: [news] Cuban: Facebook knowingly runs AI deepfake scam ads; docs say $16B fraud revenue
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from finance.yahoo.com. 256 points and 113 comments.

item.title: [news] Claude Code sends your email address to websites
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from github.com. 883 points and 292 comments.

item.title: [news] Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore returns a synthesized, source-cited answer to natural-language questions in a single tool call.

item.title: [repo] adn-dan/taxonero
item.description: Self-hosted application that uses AI to identify animal and plant species in user photos from Immich or local folders without modifying the original images.

item.title: [repo] yucezerey/turkish-anti-ai-skill
item.description: Turkish-anti-ai-skill is an open-source agent skill and humanizer that removes AI writing patterns and unnatural translationese from Turkish texts to rebuild authentic sentence architecture.

item.title: [news] Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
item.description: Cult.fit uses Codex to help teams across functions build tools and accelerate internal workflows.

item.title: [news] Hungary: Communist-era files released, up to 60k former agents revealed
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from euronews.com. 200 points and 51 comments.

item.title: [paper] User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
item.description: Research paper proposing a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework using sparse autoencoders to recover interpretable behavioral modes from opaque user embeddings for recommendation systems.

item.title: [paper] Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
item.description: Research paper examining 371 scientific figures to find that generative AI revisions can increase clarity ratings while decreasing aesthetic coherence.

item.title: [paper] Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
item.description: Method that studies where and why grounded reasoning is useful, finding it improves counting and helps when tasks require undescribable visual references.

item.title: [paper] SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
item.description: Framework called SwarmEvolve that uses latent agent swarms to perform fast and low-cost program search for mathematical discovery and scientific computing.

item.title: [paper] Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
item.description: Evaluation environment called Scientist World where every research paper becomes an executable environment to assess and train autonomous AI-scientists.

item.title: [paper] EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
item.description: Framework called EgoGeneralist that adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video learning.

item.title: [paper] XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
item.description: Benchmark called XStack that evaluates coding agents on migrating machine learning repositories between PyTorch and JAX frameworks and hardware ecosystems.

item.title: [paper] Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
item.description: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs.

item.title: [paper] Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
item.description: Language models called Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels that map residual stream directions to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions.

item.title: [paper] Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness
item.description: Study analyzing the dynamics of deterministic gradient descent with large step sizes in adversarial training to understand implicit bias, optimization, and loss sharpness.

item.title: [paper] Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
item.description: Systematic comparison between on-policy distillation and group relative policy optimization to measure compute efficiency and accuracy across various tasks and models.

item.title: [paper] ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
item.description: Agent workflow called ReproBridge that constructs standardized, reproducible machine learning artifacts to improve reproduction success rates and reduce downstream API spending.

item.title: [paper] VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
item.description: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion.

item.title: [paper] A Hidden Markov Preference Model for Online Prediction of Adversary Actions
item.description: Hidden Markov preference model for online prediction of adversary actions that uses a feasibility-masked tree of executable actions and achieves high filtering performance on cyber defense benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Edge-Assisted Crowdsensing for Explainable Cyclist Safety Perception
item.description: Edge-assisted crowdsensing system combining handlebar cameras, a vision-language model, and an explainable boosting machine to predict cyclist safety perception scores and attribute ratings to road infrastructure features.

item.title: [paper] Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes
item.description: Typed-decision cross-encoder model evaluation showing that label-wording augmentation improves accuracy on ordinary or borrowed words but provides no usable gain on abbreviations or opaque codes.

item.title: [paper] Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety
item.description: Survey of mechanistic interpretability for AI safety that examines internal model representations, features, circuits, and training-data attribution to evaluate how understanding model mechanisms improves safety.

item.title: [paper] SM4RT: Cascaded Feed-forward Model for 4D Reconstruction
item.description: SM4RT is a cascaded feed-forward model that sequentially reconstructs 3D geometry and estimates 3D motion from RGB videos to improve dynamic scene reconstruction and motion estimation.

item.title: [paper] MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
item.description: MedGraph is a graph memory system for long-term medical dialogue assistants that tracks changing patient states by extracting dated facts and linking medical records into chains.

item.title: [paper] The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
item.description: Meta Chat prototype that gives large language model chat interfaces a structured, permissioned view of application state to turn chat into a control layer for the entire workspace.

item.title: [paper] Failure Prediction and Classification in Vision-Language-Action Models Via Calibrated Latent Probing
item.description: VLA-Tug is a lightweight probe over vision-language-action model latent layers that enables early failure detection, classification, and runtime safety monitoring on edge devices.

item.title: [paper] Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
item.description: Data-driven framework that formulates intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem to recover continuous symmetries directly from differential equation data.

item.title: [paper] On the limitations of molecular representations
item.description: Systematic investigation of molecular representations finding that current embedding models do not capture graph structure or 3D shape better than classical fingerprints, which also suffer from non-unique representations.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
item.description: This paper introduces a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness on Terminal-Bench 2.1 to correct maintenance debt and improve evaluation accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
item.description: This paper analyzes the spectral and subspace dynamics of LoRA in supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, showing how group-mean baseline subtraction drives differences and proposing tailored configurations for each stage.

item.title: [paper] T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models
item.description: This paper proposes T3R, a training-free two-stage token pruning and attention-biasing framework that improves the accuracy-efficiency frontier of vision-language-action models for robot control.

item.title: [paper] The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
item.description: This paper introduces ProofTrace, a graph-based framework that extracts interpretable features of mathematical organization to detect AI involvement and recurring signatures in mathematical proofs.

item.title: [paper] Conformal Prediction for Time-Dependent PDEs
item.description: This paper investigates conformal prediction for surrogate models of time-dependent partial differential equations, proving theoretical limitations on exact coverage and presenting a weighted conformal prediction method for finite-sample guarantees.

item.title: [paper] Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
item.description: This paper presents Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates socially responsive whole-body motion for humanoid robots conditioned on human partner dynamics using a new interaction benchmark.

item.title: [paper] StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
item.description: This paper proposes StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for test-time reasoning that reduces token usage while matching the accuracy of standard self-consistency.

item.title: [paper] Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
item.description: This paper introduces a biology-informed and patient-disjoint evaluation framework to assess whether synthetic multi-omic cancer cohorts preserve modality-specific fidelity and cross-modality coherence.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Low-Light Enhancement for Road Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark and Edge Deployment Study
item.description: This paper benchmarks object detection models under degraded visual conditions and proposes a lightweight luminance-adaptive router that selects appropriate low-light enhancement strategies for road anomaly detection.

item.title: [paper] Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care
item.description: This paper proposes a neural network-based patient world model learned from longitudinal electronic health records to provide a shared clinical representation for health system simulations in intensive care.

item.title: [paper] Hybrid Machine Learning for Imbalanced Landing-Phase Safety Event Prediction from Flight Data
item.description: Interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework that combines an LSTM autoencoder and a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to predict multiclass landing-phase safety events from flight data with high recall.

item.title: [paper] FedReason: Large Language Models as Weight-Space Meta-Aggregators for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
item.description: FedReason framework that uses a large language model on the server to select customized aggregation programs for heterogeneous federated learning without server-side training.

item.title: [paper] Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
item.description: GraphMuon is a graph-aware optimizer that adapts matrix-aware updates to graph-propagated representations, accelerating validation-loss convergence on large-scale graph neural network benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
item.description: Muir is a linear attention model that uses sensitivity-allocated low-rank gating and matched-filter readout to improve perplexity and reasoning accuracy over existing architectures.

item.title: [paper] MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
item.description: Momasplat is a demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting and foundation models to synthesize full trajectories with dynamic object interactions from unseen base poses.

item.title: [paper] NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
item.description: NPCBench evaluates whether medical AI models can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and maintain temporally coherent diagnostic and care decisions across longitudinal nasopharyngeal carcinoma patient pathways.

item.title: [paper] VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
item.description: VisionSIM is a multi-modal robotic perception simulator that models physical measurement processes and failure modes for conventional and emerging sensors.

item.title: [paper] SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
item.description: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning (SHORE) combines a learned stability probability with an actor-critic model to achieve faster learning and higher space utilization in online 3D bin packing.

item.title: [paper] StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
item.description: StrataFlux is a memory-hierarchy-native inference framework that improves accuracy for low-bit quantized large language models by streaming precision from host RAM and solid-state drives.

item.title: [paper] SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains
item.description: SpecCTMC is a training-free speculative sampler for masked diffusion language models that uses parallel evaluation and an exact correction procedure to reduce sequential model evaluations without changing the output distribution.

item.title: [paper] OraRefer: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Photograph Fusion for Oral Cancer Screening with Guaranteed Patient-Level Sensitivity
item.description: OraRefer is a patient-level screening framework that uses segmentation-guided fusion and guaranteed sensitivity thresholds to detect oral cancer and precancerous disorders from multiple smartphone photographs.

item.title: [paper] A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
item.description: Theoretical analysis of a bilevel optimization formulation for combined local-global optical flow models establishes conditions for the existence and properties of optimal regularization parameters.

item.title: [paper] Unifying Central Flow, Rod Flow, and the Edge Coupling
item.description: Edge coupling framework unifies central flow and rod flow models for gradient descent and momentum methods, tracking discrete iterates across all phases of neural network training.

item.title: [paper] USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
item.description: USB Gym is a simulation testbed for evaluating and combining modular methods for closed-loop ultrasound probe guidance toward target anatomical views.

item.title: [paper] 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
item.description: 4D Point Splatting is a physics-based differentiable renderer that reconstructs moving 3D scenes from real millimeter-wave radar captures to improve downstream sensing models.

item.title: [paper] Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
item.description: Locality-aware quantization improves the global structure and fidelity of compressed vector embeddings in AI agent memory systems without losing retrieval performance.

item.title: [paper] Discovering Learning Rules that Shape Others
item.description: Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping meta-learns update rules that enable reinforcement learning agents to successfully influence opponents in general-sum games without accessing their internal parameters.

item.title: [paper] Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions
item.description: Sandbox evaluation framework demonstrates that memory mechanisms enable large language models to continuously adapt their cultural norms and language use through repeated social interactions.

item.title: [paper] InstantHand: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Hand Avatar Reconstruction from a Single Image
item.description: InstantHand is a feed-forward framework that rapidly constructs animatable 3D Gaussian hand avatars from a single image using specialized regularization and appearance transfer techniques.

item.title: [paper] Decision Models as Retrieval Gates Against Injection and Pollution
item.description: Open-weight decision models serve as efficient retrieval gates to screen out prompt injections and polluted text from retrieved web pages before they reach language models.

item.title: [paper] Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
item.description: Multitask learning strategies integrate syntactic knowledge into neural sentiment analysis models to improve polarity classification performance across multiple languages and datasets.

item.title: [paper] Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
item.description: Controlled experiments reveal that criteria exposure causes self-improving embodied agents to overfit to benchmark verifiers rather than learning transferable task skills.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
item.description: A benchmark evaluation across five heterogeneous knowledge graphs demonstrates that graph grounding significantly reduces hallucination rates in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable many-body interaction laws for collective motion from few trajectories
item.description: The directional atomic cluster expansion framework recovers interpretable many-body interaction laws for collective motion from limited trajectory data.

item.title: [paper] LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
item.description: An LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline identifies and removes unreliable sleep-stage annotations during training to improve automated classification accuracy.

item.title: [paper] RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
item.description: RM-VLM generates reward machines from natural-language descriptions using a large language model and grounds them with a vision-language model for reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
item.description: A parallel decoding method for diffusion language models measures coupling probes inside the main forward pass to commit tokens faster with high accuracy.

item.title: [paper] GINGER: Spicing Up Graph-Based Vector Search
item.description: Ginger is an open-source C++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search that improves query throughput and memory efficiency on large embedding datasets.

item.title: [paper] First-Token Attraction in Mamba Dynamics
item.description: An analytical framework based on invariant boxes proves that the first token in deep Mamba models exerts a strong attracting influence, driving token clustering.

item.title: [paper] Dynamic Optimistic Constrained OCO with Memory via Delay Equivalence
item.description: An optimistic algorithm for online convex optimization with memory and time-varying constraints incorporates untrusted predictions to bound regret and constraint violations.

item.title: [news] Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
item.description: Australian universities are integrating ChatGPT and AI tools into their teaching and learning programs to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

item.title: [paper] Transformer-Based Trajectory Prescription for sEMG-Optimizing Robot-Mediated Rehabilitation
item.description: Personalizable transformer-based model that maps muscle activations to prescribed contact force trajectories, enabling neuromotor-optimized robot-mediated rehabilitation.

item.title: [paper] ManimCode: Learning Visual Self-Correction for Educational Animation
item.description: ManimCode is a data and training framework that uses feedback-driven reinforcement learning to train models to write, review, and revise educational animation programs.

item.title: [paper] AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
item.description: AutoCompress is a hardware-guided compression framework that uses differentiable architecture search to prune large language models while meeting specific hardware and latency constraints.

item.title: [paper] Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
item.description: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting is an online 3D reconstruction method using beta kernels to improve geometry confidence, rendering speed, and optimization efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
item.description: Interactive Visual Gym is a closed-loop evaluation framework that simulates task environments and human users to benchmark visual interaction models.

item.title: [paper] A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing
item.description: Generative model of contextual integrity that uses interacting large language models to study appropriate and inappropriate information sharing across different conversational scenarios.

item.title: [paper] Multimodal-SEA: Benchmarking AI Agent Security under Multimodal Social Engineering Attacks
item.description: Multimodal-SEA is an interactive benchmark comprising 608 expert-designed tasks to evaluate the intrinsic security of personal AI agents against multimodal social engineering attacks.

item.title: [paper] LeanContext: Disentangling Mathematical Resources from Local Formal Context in Lean Whole-Proof Generation
item.description: LeanContext is a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems designed to evaluate retrieved mathematical resources and project context in neural theorem proving.

item.title: [paper] Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
item.description: Shape-teacher alignment is a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation to transfer geometric structure to image-based robot policy encoders.

item.title: [paper] Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
item.description: Scalable safe reinforcement learning method using a phase-aggregated cost estimator and constraint tightening to support massively parallel training regimes with short rollouts.

item.title: [paper] DART: Domain-Agnostic Residual Transfer for Generalist Anomaly Detection
item.description: DART is a plug-in framework for generalist anomaly detection that separates residuals into anomaly-relevant and domain-specific components to improve cross-domain transfer performance.

item.title: [paper] Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
item.description: Study on LLM code repairs reveals that standard release checks and tests frequently accept incorrectly repaired programs after API migrations.

item.title: [paper] SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
item.description: SplatAnything introduces Gaussian Spacing Normalization to canonicalize a scene-level spacing statistic, improving feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting across varying scales and viewpoints.

item.title: [paper] Scaling Neural Motor Decoding via Decoupled Behavioral Pretraining
item.description: BEEMO is a multi-session neural motor decoding framework that decouples behavioral and neural representation learning to scale training with unpaired behavioral data.

item.title: [paper] The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
item.description: Investigation into the internal representations of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct shows that prompt framing reshapes representational geometry more strongly than assigned persona identity.

item.title: [paper] Nowcasting of Tropical Cyclone Wind Fields and Intensity from Geostationary Imagery
item.description: Neural networks predict 2D surface wind fields and storm intensity from geostationary satellite imagery to improve tropical cyclone nowcasting.

item.title: [paper] Series-wise Cross-validation for Global Time Series Forecasting
item.description: Series-wise cross-validation partitioning for global time series forecasting improves downstream accuracy by guiding model selection toward better generalization across series and time.

item.title: [paper] Geometric Relevance Is Not Sufficient: Evaluating Focused Post-Training Supervision in Diffusion Docking
item.description: Study on diffusion-based molecular docking evaluates focused versus broad post-training supervision strategies, finding that broad continuation achieves higher mean Top-1 success.

item.title: [paper] Value-oriented policy distillation for interpretable wind farm power control
item.description: Value-oriented policy distillation framework using explainable boosting machines creates interpretable wind farm power control policies that significantly reduce grid imbalance costs.

item.title: [paper] FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
item.description: FewStepRL adapts reinforcement learning objectives for few-step diffusion models by transforming, decomposing, and adapting gradients to efficiently fine-tune generative models.

item.title: [paper] Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
item.description: TB-MathModel is a terminal-style benchmark that evaluates mathematical modeling agents using verifiable contest-style problems and multi-reference scoring.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers
item.description: SSoG is a separable sum-of-Gaussians spatial operator that replaces dense self-attention in Vision Transformers to reduce computational costs and improve accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Signals, Evidence, and Context: User Scrutiny in Real-World LLM Conversations
item.description: Study of user scrutiny in nearly 500,000 LLM conversations reveals how attribution language and uncertainty features influence whether users check or challenge assistant responses.

item.title: [paper] From Twisted Facts to Rogue Agents: Can LLMs Reliably Detect Multi-Dimensional Hallucinations?
item.description: HaluCheck is a large-scale bilingual benchmark comprising over 42,000 instances designed to evaluate and diagnose multi-dimensional hallucinations in text and agent trajectories.

item.title: [paper] Domain-specific information retrieval
item.description: Review of domain-specific information retrieval explores common tasks, unique challenges like long documents, and transferable methodological advances.

item.title: [paper] "Blind Compliance": Coercive Control in AI Jailbreaking
